answer: Quick check before I dig in: back in November you mentioned you'd stopped the Saturday classes entirely and your weekends had shifted to restoring the '78 Vespa — have you picked dancing back up since then? If you're back in class, tell me what tempo they're drilling and I'll build you a proper slow-to-fast playlist.
